dct_description_sm: The objectives of this work are to map hazards to better inform planning and to facilitate communication on climate change risks as well as to assess vulnerability in two Ogemawahj Tribal Council communities. The study will focus on the following: (1) identification and mapping of climate change hazards using geomatic information systems; (2) application of climate change vulnerability assessment methods to two Ogemawahj Tribal Council First Nations (to be determined).
